content: {"like":["Enjoys high‑quality action in martial‑arts epics like Once Upon A Time In Shanghai","Prefers strong performances from classic Western stars such as John Wayne in Rio Bravo","Values intriguing, well‑executed plots in sci‑fi thrillers like In Time","Appreciates suspenseful crime dramas with unique twists such as F/X","Likes improved visual quality in Blu‑ray releases over standard DVDs"],"dislike":["Dislikes excessive foul language in action‑drama films like Brotherhood and Bad Boys","Avoids overly sordid or gratuitously sexual content in Westerns","Rejects movies with too much martial arts action that feels forced, as in Wolf Warrior","Prefers minimal romance in Westerns, not too much, as in Rio Bravo","Dislikes films that overuse profanity throughout, such as Bad Boys"]}
